name: AICTE Grant for Organizing Conference
benefit:
> ***Financial Assistance***

**Category A Conferences**

- Financial assistance equal to one-third of the total conference expenditure.
- Maximum assistance up to ₹3,00,000.
- Applicable for conferences organized in AICTE pre-defined themes.

**Category B Conferences**

- Financial assistance equal to one-third of the total conference expenditure.
- Maximum assistance up to ₹2,00,000.

_eligibility_text: **General Eligibility** 1. The applicant institution should be approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). 1. The applicant institution should have at least 8 years of existence. 1. The applicant institution should organize conferences in approved technical or management disciplines. 1. The applicant institution should preferably have National Board of Accreditation (NBA) accredited departments. 1. The applicant institution should possess in-house expertise in the proposed conference theme. 1. The applicant institution should invite overseas participants for international conferences. 1. The applicant institution should include at least 3 eminent national or international experts as keynote speakers. 1. The applicant institution should organize conferences for a minimum duration of 2 days. 1. The applicant institution should maintain a dedicated conference webpage. **Eligibility of Coordinator** 1. The applicant coordinator should be a full-time regular Associate Professor, Professor, or senior faculty member. 1. The applicant coordinator should possess at least 10 years of teaching and research experience. 1. The applicant coordinator should have research publications. 1. The applicant coordinator should have organized: - At least 3 conferences for international conference applications - At least 1 conference for national conference applications **Eligibility of Co-Coordinator** 1. The applicant institution should identify a co-coordinator. 1. The co-coordinator should possess at least 7 years of teaching and research experience. 1. The co-coordinator should have organized at least 1 conference for international conference applications.
